3077.title: Late thread-start settlement logs a redundant lifecycle transition
3077.rootCauseOneLine: When a provider turn-start event activates a new thread before its thread-start RPC settles, the settlement applies run.started a second time and logs the deliberate active-state no-op.
3077.proposedFix: Skip the redundant run.started application in thread-start settlement when the provider event has already left the same clean thread active, mirroring the existing inverse-order guard.
3077.caveats: The deterministic server test simulates the provider event/RPC ordering; no external ACP process or user runtime data was used. The thread remains active, so the verified defect is noisy lifecycle reporting rather than a broken thread state.
